theorem minor_arcs_input (N : ℕ) (hN27 : 10 ^ 27 ≤ N) :
    ∫ α in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 \ majorArcs 8 r₀ (xOf N),
        ‖S etaStar (xOf N) α‖ * ‖S etaPlus (xOf N) α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1.0376 * xOf N ^ 2 / κ :=

note: Lean proves only the specialization (φ = t²e^{−t²/2}, κ = 49, r₀ = 150000), with arcs at scale x/κ above the base level, levels up to ≈ x^{0.3}, c₊ = 2 and gx constants 0.8764, 2.526, 3.8 (book 0.5, 2.5, 3.36); final constant 1.0376 vs the book's 1.00948. Erratum: The l^infty input (13.14)-(13.17) is proved only off M_{8,r}(y), y = x/kappa, while H(r) uses arcs at scale x (c- = 0.6394 fits log(1/4) + log 2 + c_E = 0.639435 at scale x; at scale y it would be -1.30648); just outside M_{8,r0}(x) Prop 11.2.3 at scale y gives only g(r0/kappa) = 6.776 g(r0) (kappa = 49, r0 = 150000, y = 10^25). (checked by `scripts/checks/theorem_13_2_1.py`).
